Unindexed older analyses remain a publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: W_n is the published, uniformly dimensioned example exposing failure of a geometric lemma beyond codimension two. The sharp projection constant quantifies its actual complementability cost, rather than just improving a guessed coefficient. It answers the complete natural minimum-projection question for the whole family and distinguishes feasible bounds from optimality with an explicit global dual certificate. No general higher-codimension conjecture is claimed.
